1210: # =============================================================================
1211: # ERROR HANDLERS
1212: # =============================================================================
1213: @app.errorhandler(401)
1214: def unauthorized(e):
1215:     """Unauthorized - user isn't logged in but tried to access a protected page."""
1216:     # This will usually be caught by your require_login() redirect first,
1217:     # but just in case Flask's auth machinery triggers it:
1218:     return redirect(url_for('login'))
1219: 
1220: @app.errorhandler(404)
1221: def page_not_found(e):
1222:     """Page not found - user followed a broken link or typed a wrong URL."""
1223:     return render_template('errors/404.html'), 404
1224:

1243: @app.errorhandler(429)
1244: def ratelimit_handler(e):
1245:     """Return a user-friendly message when rate limit is exceeded."""
1246:     # e.description contains the custom error message
1247:     error_message = e.description if e.description else "Too many requests. Please slow down."
1248:     return render_template('errors/429.html', error_message=error_message), 429

1251: # ROUTES - PUBLIC
1252: # =============================================================================
1253: @app.route("/")
1254: @limiter.exempt
1255: def home():
1256:     """Show landing page for non-logged-in users, dashboard for logged-in users."""
1257:     if not session.get("user_id"):
1258:         region = get_user_region()
1259:         pricing = get_pricing(region)
1260:         return render_template("landing.html", pricing=pricing)
1261: 
1262:     user_id = session["user_id"]
1263:     
1264:     # Check if suspended FIRST
1265:     if is_user_suspended(user_id):
1266:         session.clear()
1267:         flash("❌ Your account has been suspended. Please contact support.", "error")
1268:         return redirect(url_for("login"))
1269:     
1270:     # Get subscription status
1271:     sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
1272:     tier = sub_status['tier']
1273:     status = sub_status['status']
1274:     is_active = sub_status['is_active']
1275:     documents_trimmed = sub_status.get('documents_trimmed', False)
1276: 
1277:     # Check if trial has expired (for both Pro and VIP)
1278:     if tier in ['pro', 'vip'] and status == 'active' and sub_status.get('trial_used', False):
1279:         trial_ends_at = sub_status.get('trial_ends_at')
1280:         if trial_ends_at and trial_ends_at <= datetime.now(timezone.utc):
1281:             # Trial expired - downgrade to free
1282:             conn = get_db()
1283:             try:
1284:                 cursor = conn.cursor()
1285:                 # Trim documents if over limit
1286:                 trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
1287:                 cursor.execute("""
1288:                     UPDATE users 
1289:                     SET subscription_tier = 'free',
1290:                         subscription_status = 'expired',
1291:                         subscription_expiry = NULL,
1292:                         trial_ends_at = NULL
1293:                     WHERE id = %s
1294:                 """, (user_id,))
1295:                 conn.commit()
1296:                 cursor.close()
1297:                 flash("⚠️ Your free trial has ended. Upgrade to continue using Pro features.", "warning")
1298:                 return redirect(url_for("home"))
1299:             except Exception as e:
1300:                 print(f"❌ Error ending trial: {e}")
1301:                 flash("An error occurred. Please contact support.", "error")
1302:                 return redirect(url_for("home"))
1303:             finally:
1304:                 put_db(conn)
1305:     
1306:     # REMOVE GRACE PERIOD CODE - Just handle expired subscriptions directly
1307:     if tier != 'free' and tier != 'suspended' and not is_active:
1308:         # Subscription expired - downgrade immediately
1309:         deleted_count = trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
1310:         
1311:         conn = get_db()
1312:         try:
1313:             cursor = conn.cursor()
1314:             cursor.execute("""
1315:                 UPDATE users 
1316:                 SET subscription_tier = 'free',
1317:                     subscription_status = 'expired',
1318:                     subscription_expiry = NULL,
1319:                     documents_trimmed = TRUE
1320:                 WHERE id = %s
1321:             """, (user_id,))
1322:             conn.commit()
1323:             cursor.close()
1324:         finally:
1325:             put_db(conn)
1326:         
1327:         if deleted_count > 0:
1328:             flash(
1329:                 f"⚠️ Your subscription has expired. We've kept your 20 most important documents "
1330:                 f"(farthest from expiry) and removed {deleted_count} documents. "
1331:                 f"Upgrade to Pro or VIP to track more than 20 documents.",
1332:                 "warning"
1333:             )
1334:         else:
1335:             flash("⚠️ Your subscription has expired. You're now on the Free plan.", "warning")
1336:         
1337:         # Refresh subscription status
1338:         sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
1339:         tier = sub_status['tier']
1340:         status = sub_status['status']
1341:         documents_trimmed = True
1342:     
1343:     # Get document count
1344:     doc_count = get_document_count(user_id)
1345:     
1346:     # If on free plan and over limit (shouldn't happen after trim, but just in case)
1347:     if tier == 'free' and doc_count > 20:
1348:         deleted_count = trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
1349:         if deleted_count > 0:
1350:             flash(
1351:                 f"⚠️ You have more than 20 documents on the Free plan. "
1352:                 f"We've kept your 20 most important documents (farthest from expiry) "
1353:                 f"and removed {deleted_count} documents. "
1354:                 f"Upgrade to Pro or VIP to track more than 20 documents.",
1355:                 "warning"
1356:             )
1357:             doc_count = get_document_count(user_id)
1358:     
1359:     search_query = request.args.get("q", "").strip()
1360:     status_filter = request.args.get("status", "")
1361: 
1362:     docs = get_documents(user_id, search_query)
1363:     documents = []
1364: 
1365:     for doc_id, title, expiry_date in docs:
1366:         days_left, doc_status, color, icon = get_status(expiry_date)
1367: 
1368:         if status_filter and doc_status != status_filter:
1369:             continue
1370: 
1371:         if days_left < 0:
1372:             display_days = f"{abs(days_left)} days overdue"
1373:         else:
1374:             display_days = f"{days_left} days left"
1375: 
1376:         documents.append({
1377:             "id": doc_id,
1378:             "title": title,
1379:             "expiry_date": expiry_date,
1380:             "display_days": display_days,
1381:             "status": doc_status,
1382:             "color": color,
1383:             "icon": icon
1384:         })
1385: 
1386:     # ALWAYS return here at the end
1387:     return render_template(
1388:         "index.html", 
1389:         documents=documents, 
1390:         doc_count=doc_count,  
1391:         subscription_tier=tier,
1392:         subscription_status=status,
1393:         subscription_expiry=sub_status.get('expiry'),
1394:         on_trial=sub_status.get('on_trial', False),
1395:         trial_ends_at=sub_status.get('trial_ends_at'),
1396:         now=datetime.now(timezone.utc)
1397:     )
1398:

1400: @limiter.exempt

1402:     """Health check endpoint for UptimeRobot — no rate limit."""
1403:     return "OK", 200

1409: @app.route("/contact", methods=["GET", "POST"])
1410: @limiter.limit("10 per hour", error_message="Too many contact form submissions. Please try again later.")
1411: def contact():
1412:     """Contact page for support and business inquiries. Also handles
1413:     feedback submissions (routed here from /feedback so they share one
1414:     inquiries table and one notification/auto-reply pipeline)."""
1415:     error = None
1416:     success = None
1417: 
1418:     if request.method == "POST":
1419:         name = request.form.get("name", "").strip()
1420:         email = request.form.get("email", "").strip().lower()
1421:         subject = request.form.get("subject", "").strip()
1422:         message = request.form.get("message", "").strip()
1423:         inquiry_type = request.form.get("inquiry_type", "support")
1424:         is_feedback = inquiry_type == "feedback"
1425: 
1426:         # Validation
1427:         if not name:
1428:             error = "Please enter your name."
1429:         elif not email:
1430:             error = "Please enter your email address."
1431:         else:
1432:             try:
1433:                 validate_email(email)
1434:             except EmailNotValidError:
1435:                 error = "Please enter a valid email address."
1436: 
1437:         if not error and not subject:
1438:             error = "Please enter a subject."
1439:         elif not error and (not message or len(message) < 10):
1440:             error = "Please enter a message (at least 10 characters)."
1441: 
1442:         if not error:
1443:             try:
1444:                 # Store in database
1445:                 conn = get_db()
1446:                 try:
1447:                     cursor = conn.cursor()
1448:                     cursor.execute("""
1449:                         INSERT INTO contact_inquiries 
1450:                         (name, email, subject, message, inquiry_type, created_at)
1451:                         VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
1452:                         RETURNING id
1453:                     """, (name, email, subject, message, inquiry_type, datetime.now(timezone.utc)))
1454:                     inquiry_id = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1455:                     conn.commit()
1456:                     cursor.close()
1457:                 finally:
1458:                     put_db(conn)
1459: 
1460:                 # Send notification to you (support@fritt.org or your personal email)
1461:                 send_inquiry_notification(name, email, subject, message, inquiry_type, inquiry_id)
1462: 
1463:                 # Send auto-reply to user
1464:                 send_auto_reply(email, name, inquiry_type)
1465: 
1466:                 if is_feedback:
1467:                     flash("✅ Thanks for your feedback! We read every submission.", "success")
1468:                     return redirect(url_for("home"))
1469: 
1470:                 success = "✅ Your message has been sent! We'll get back to you within 24 hours."
1471: 
1472:             except Exception as e:
1473:                 print(f"❌ Error saving inquiry: {e}")
1474:                 error = "Something went wrong. Please try again later."
1475: 
1476:         # Validation failed, or the try block above raised before returning
1477:         if error and is_feedback:
1478:             return render_template("feedback.html", error=error)
1479: 
1480:     return render_template("contact.html", error=error, success=success)
1481: 
1482: @app.route("/business", methods=["GET", "POST"])
1483: @limiter.limit("10 per hour", error_message="Too many business inquiries. Please try again later.")
1484: def business():
1485:     """Business inquiries page."""
1486:     error = None
1487:     success = None
1488:     
1489:     if request.method == "POST":
1490:         name = request.form.get("name", "").strip()
1491:         email = request.form.get("email", "").strip().lower()
1492:         company = request.form.get("company", "").strip()
1493:         team_size = request.form.get("team_size", "")
1494:         message = request.form.get("message", "").strip()
1495:         
1496:         # Validation
1497:         if not name:
1498:             error = "Please enter your name."
1499:         elif not email:
1500:             error = "Please enter your email address."
1501:         else:
1502:             try:
1503:                 validate_email(email)
1504:             except EmailNotValidError:
1505:                 error = "Please enter a valid email address."
1506: 
1507:         if not error and not company:
1508:             error = "Please enter your company name."
1509:         elif not error and (not message or len(message) < 10):
1510:             error = "Please enter a message (at least 10 characters)."
1511: 
1512:         if not error:
1513:             try:
1514:                 # Store in database
1515:                 conn = get_db()
1516:                 try:
1517:                     cursor = conn.cursor()
1518:                     cursor.execute("""
1519:                         INSERT INTO business_inquiries 
1520:                         (name, email, company, team_size, message, created_at)
1521:                         VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
1522:                         RETURNING id
1523:                     """, (name, email, company, team_size, message, datetime.now(timezone.utc)))
1524:                     inquiry_id = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1525:                     conn.commit()
1526:                     cursor.close()
1527:                 finally:
1528:                     put_db(conn)
1529:                 
1530:                 # Send notification to you
1531:                 send_business_inquiry_notification(name, email, company, team_size, message, inquiry_id)
1532:                 
1533:                 # Send auto-reply
1534:                 send_business_auto_reply(email, name)
1535:                 
1536:                 success = "✅ Thank you! A team member will contact you within 24 hours."
1537:                 
1538:             except Exception as e:
1539:                 print(f"❌ Error saving business inquiry: {e}")
1540:                 error = "Something went wrong. Please try again later."
1541:     
1542:     return render_template("business.html", error=error, success=success)

1544: def send_inquiry_notification(name, email, subject, message, inquiry_type, inquiry_id):
1545:     """Send notification to you (the admin)."""
1546:     if not RESEND_API_KEY:
1547:         print(f"📧 New {inquiry_type} inquiry from {name} ({email}): {subject}")
1548:         return
1549:     
1550:     try:
1551:         # Send to your personal email (or support@fritt.org later)
1552:         if not ADMIN_EMAIL:
1553:             print(f"⚠️ WARNING: ADMIN_EMAIL not set. Inquiry from {email} was not sent.")
1554:             return
1555:         
1556:         response = requests.post(
1557:             "https://api.resend.com/emails",
1558:             headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {RESEND_API_KEY}"},
1559:             json={
1560:                 "from": RESEND_FROM_EMAIL,
1561:                 "to": [ADMIN_EMAIL],
1562:                 "reply_to": [email],
1563:                 "subject": f"[Fritt Tracker] New {inquiry_type} inquiry: {subject}",
1564:                 "html": f"""
1565:                     <h2>New {inquiry_type.capitalize()} Inquiry</h2>
1566:                     <p><strong>From:</strong> {name} ({email})</p>
1567:                     <p><strong>Subject:</strong> {subject}</p>
1568:                     <p><strong>Message:</strong></p>
1569:                     <p>{message.replace(chr(10), '<br>')}</p>
1570:                     <hr>
1571:                     <p><strong>Inquiry ID:</strong> #{inquiry_id}</p>
1572:                     <p><strong>Type:</strong> {inquiry_type}</p>
1573:                     <p>Reply directly to this email to respond to {name}.</p>
1574:                 """,
1575:                 "text": f"""
1576:                     New {inquiry_type} Inquiry
1577:                     
1578:                     From: {name} ({email})
1579:                     Subject: {subject}
1580:                     
1581:                     Message:
1582:                     {message}
1583:                     
1584:                     Inquiry ID: #{inquiry_id}
1585:                     Type: {inquiry_type}
1586:                 """
1587:             },
1588:             timeout=10
1589:         )
1590:         if response.status_code >= 400:
1591:             print(f"⚠️ Failed to send inquiry notification: {response.text}")
1592:     except Exception as e:
1593:         print(f"⚠️ Error sending inquiry notification: {e}")
1594:

1614:                 <p style="font-size: 14px; color: #6b7280;">
1615:                     This is an automated response. Our team will personally follow up with you soon.
1616:                 </p>
1617:             """
1618:             text_body = f"""
1619:                 Thank you for reaching out, {user_name}!
1620:                 
1621:                 We've received your business inquiry and a team member will get back to you within 24 hours.
1622:                 
1623:                 In the meantime, you can:
1624:                 - Create your free account: https://tracker.fritt.org/register

1673:                             .content {{ padding: 30px; background: #f9fafb; }}
1674:                             .footer {{ text-align: center; padding: 20px; color: #6b7280; font-size: 14px; }}
1675:                         </style>
1676:                     </head>
1677:                     <body>
1678:                         <div class="container">
1679:                             <div class="header">

1683:                                 {body}

1699:         )
1700:         if response.status_code >= 400:

1714:         if not ADMIN_EMAIL:
1715:             print(f"⚠️ WARNING: ADMIN_EMAIL not set. Inquiry from {email} was not sent.")
1716:             return
1717:         
1718:         response = requests.post(
1719:             "https://api.resend.com/emails",

1728:                     <p><strong>Name:</strong> {name}</p>
1729:                     <p><strong>Email:</strong> {email}</p>

1731:                     <p><strong>Team Size:</strong> {team_size or 'Not specified'}</p>
1732:                     <p><strong>Message:</strong></p>
1733:                     <p>{message.replace(chr(10), '<br>')}</p>

1736:                 """,

1739:                     
1740:                     Name: {name}

1743:                     Team Size: {team_size or 'Not specified'}
1744:                     
1745:                     Message:
1746:                     {message}
1747:                     
1748:                     Inquiry ID: #{inquiry_id}
1749:                 """
1750:             },
1751:             timeout=10
1752:         )
1753:         if response.status_code >= 400:
1754:             print(f"⚠️ Failed to send business inquiry notification: {response.text}")
1755:     except Exception as e:

1766: 
1767: def require_admin():
1768:     """Decorator-like function to require admin access."""
1769:     if not session.get("user_id"):
1770:         flash("Please log in to access the admin area.", "warning")
1771:         return redirect(url_for("login"))
1772:     
1773:     if not is_admin():
1774:         flash("You don't have permission to access the admin area.", "error")
1775:         abort(403)
1776:     
1777:     return None

1780: def log_admin_action(action, target_type=None, target_id=None, details=None):
1781:     """Log admin actions for audit trail."""
1782:     if not session.get("user_id"):
1783:         return
1784:     
1785:     conn = get_db()
1786:     try:
1787:         cursor = conn.cursor()
1788:         cursor.execute("""
1789:             INSERT INTO audit_log 
1790:             (admin_id, action, target_type, target_id, details, ip_address, user_agent)
1791:             VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
1792:         """, (
1793:             session["user_id"],
1794:             action,
1795:             target_type,
1796:             target_id,
1797:             json.dumps(details) if details else None,
1798:             request.remote_addr,
1799:             request.headers.get('User-Agent')
1800:         ))
1801:         conn.commit()
1802:         cursor.close()
1803:     finally:
1804:         put_db(conn)

1807: @app.route("/admin")
1808: def admin_dashboard():
1809:     """Admin dashboard - overview of everything."""
1810:     auth = require_admin()
1811:     if auth:
1812:         return auth
1813:     
1814:     conn = get_db()
1815:     try:
1816:         cursor = conn.cursor()
1817:         
1818:         # Get stats
1819:         cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users")
1820:         total_users = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1821:         
1822:         cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE email_verified = TRUE")
1823:         verified_users = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1824:         
1825:         cursor.execute("""
1826:             SELECT subscription_tier, COUNT(*) 
1827:             FROM users 
1828:             GROUP BY subscription_tier
1829:         """)
1830:         subscription_stats = cursor.fetchall()
1831:         
1832:         cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents")
1833:         total_documents = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1834:         
1835:         cursor.execute("""
1836:             SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents 
1837:             WHERE expiry_date::date <= CURRENT_DATE
1838:         """)
1839:         expired_documents = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1840:         
1841:         cursor.execute("""
1842:             SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents 
1843:             WHERE expiry_date::date > CURRENT_DATE 
1844:             AND expiry_date::date <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '14 days'
1845:         """)
1846:         expiring_soon = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1847:         
1848:         cursor.execute("""
1849:             SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flagged_users WHERE status = 'pending'
1850:         """)
1851:         pending_flags = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1852:         
1853:         cursor.execute("""
1854:             SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contact_inquiries WHERE status = 'new'
1855:         """)
1856:         pending_inquiries = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1857:         
1858:         cursor.execute("""
1859:             SELECT id, email, subscription_tier, email_verified, created_at
1860:             FROM users 
1861:             ORDER BY created_at DESC 
1862:             LIMIT 10
1863:         """)
1864:         recent_users = cursor.fetchall()
1865:         
1866:         cursor.close()
1867:         
1868:     finally:
1869:         put_db(conn)
1870:     
1871:     return render_template(
1872:         "admin/dashboard.html",
1873:         total_users=total_users,
1874:         verified_users=verified_users,
1875:         subscription_stats=subscription_stats,
1876:         total_documents=total_documents,
1877:         expired_documents=expired_documents,
1878:         expiring_soon=expiring_soon,
1879:         pending_flags=pending_flags,
1880:         pending_inquiries=pending_inquiries,
1881:         recent_users=recent_users
1882:     )

1885: @app.route("/admin/users")
1886: def admin_users():
1887:     """View and manage all users."""
1888:     auth = require_admin()
1889:     if auth:
1890:         return auth
1891:     
1892:     search = request.args.get("search", "")
1893:     status = request.args.get("status", "all")
1894:     page = int(request.args.get("page", 1))
1895:     per_page = 20
1896:     offset = (page - 1) * per_page
1897:     
1898:     conn = get_db()
1899:     try:
1900:         cursor = conn.cursor()
1901:         
1902:         # Build query
1903:         query = """
1904:             SELECT u.id, u.email, u.email_verified, u.subscription_tier, 
1905:                    u.subscription_status, u.created_at,
1906:                    COUNT(d.id) as doc_count,
1907:                    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_users a WHERE a.user_id = u.id) as is_admin,
1908:                    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM flagged_users f WHERE f.user_id = u.id AND f.status = 'pending') as is_flagged
1909:             FROM users u
1910:             LEFT JOIN documents d ON d.user_id = u.id
1911:         """
1912:         where_clauses = []
1913:         params = []
1914:         
1915:         if search:
1916:             where_clauses.append("u.email ILIKE %s")
1917:             params.append(f"%{search}%")
1918:         
1919:         if status == "verified":
1920:             where_clauses.append("u.email_verified = TRUE")
1921:         elif status == "unverified":
1922:             where_clauses.append("u.email_verified = FALSE")
1923:         elif status == "flagged":
1924:             where_clauses.append("EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM flagged_users f WHERE f.user_id = u.id AND f.status = 'pending')")
1925:         elif status == "admin":
1926:             where_clauses.append("EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_users a WHERE a.user_id = u.id)")
1927:         
1928:         if where_clauses:
1929:             query += " WHERE " + " AND ".join(where_clauses)
1930:         
1931:         query += " GROUP BY u.id ORDER BY u.created_at DESC LIMIT %s OFFSET %s"
1932:         params.extend([per_page, offset])
1933:         
1934:         cursor.execute(query, params)
1935:         users = cursor.fetchall()
1936:         
1937:         # Get total count for pagination
1938:         count_query = "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM users u"
1939:         if where_clauses:
1940:             count_query += " WHERE " + " AND ".join(where_clauses)
1941:         cursor.execute(count_query, params[:-2])  # Exclude LIMIT/OFFSET
1942:         total_users = cursor.fetchone()[0]
1943:         
1944:         cursor.close()
1945:         
1946:     finally:
1947:         put_db(conn)
1948:     
1949:     return render_template(
1950:         "admin/users.html",
1951:         users=users,
1952:         total_users=total_users,
1953:         page=page,
1954:         per_page=per_page,
1955:         search=search,
1956:         status=status
1957:     )

1960: @app.route("/admin/user/<int:user_id>")
1961: def admin_user_detail(user_id):
1962:     """View detailed user information."""
1963:     auth = require_admin()
1964:     if auth:
1965:         return auth
1966:     
1967:     conn = get_db()
1968:     try:
1969:         cursor = conn.cursor()
1970:         
1971:         # Make sure user[5] (subscription_expiry) is timezone-aware
1972:         # When fetching user data, ensure expiry is timezone-aware
1973:         cursor.execute("""
1974:             SELECT u.id, u.email, u.email_verified, u.subscription_tier,
1975:                 u.subscription_status, u.subscription_expiry, u.created_at,
1976:                 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_users a WHERE a.user_id = u.id) as is_admin,
1977:                 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM flagged_users f WHERE f.user_id = u.id AND f.status = 'pending') as is_flagged
1978:             FROM users u
1979:             WHERE u.id = %s
1980:         """, (user_id,))
1981:         user = cursor.fetchone()
1982: 
1983:         # Convert expiry to timezone-aware if needed
1984:         if user and user[5] and user[5].tzinfo is None:
1985:             user = list(user)
1986:             user[5] = user[5].replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
1987:             user = tuple(user)
1988:         
1989:         if not user:
1990:             abort(404)
1991:         
1992:         # Get user documents - just get the raw data
1993:         cursor.execute("""
1994:             SELECT id, title, expiry_date
1995:             FROM documents
1996:             WHERE user_id = %s
1997:             ORDER BY expiry_date ASC
1998:         """, (user_id,))
1999:         raw_documents = cursor.fetchall()
2000:         
2001:         # Process documents through get_status() for consistency
2002:         documents = []
2003:         for doc_id, title, expiry_date in raw_documents:
2004:             days_left, status, color, icon = get_status(expiry_date)
2005:             documents.append({
2006:                 'id': doc_id,
2007:                 'title': title,
2008:                 'expiry_date': expiry_date,
2009:                 'days_left': days_left,
2010:                 'status': status,
2011:                 'color': color,
2012:                 'icon': icon
2013:             })
2014:         
2015:         # Get user activity logs
2016:         cursor.execute("""
2017:             SELECT action, details, created_at
2018:             FROM user_activity_logs
2019:             WHERE user_id = %s
2020:             ORDER BY created_at DESC
2021:             LIMIT 50
2022:         """, (user_id,))
2023:         activity_logs = cursor.fetchall()
2024:         
2025:         # Get audit logs for this user
2026:         cursor.execute("""
2027:             SELECT action, target_type, details, created_at
2028:             FROM audit_log
2029:             WHERE target_type = 'user' AND target_id = %s
2030:             ORDER BY created_at DESC
2031:             LIMIT 20
2032:         """, (user_id,))
2033:         audit_logs = cursor.fetchall()
2034:         
2035:         cursor.close()
2036:         
2037:     finally:
2038:         put_db(conn)
2039:     
2040:     now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
2041:     
2042:     return render_template(
2043:         "admin/user_detail.html",
2044:         user=user,
2045:         documents=documents,
2046:         activity_logs=activity_logs,
2047:         audit_logs=audit_logs,
2048:         now=now
2049:     )

2051: @app.route("/admin/user/<int:user_id>/action", methods=["POST"])
2052: def admin_user_action(user_id):
2053:     """Perform actions on a user (suspend, verify, make admin, etc.)."""
2054:     auth = require_admin()
2055:     if auth:
2056:         return auth
2057:     
2058:     action = request.form.get("action")
2059:     
2060:     if not action:
2061:         flash("No action specified.", "error")
2062:         return redirect(url_for("admin_user_detail", user_id=user_id))
2063:     
2064:     conn = get_db()
2065:     try:
2066:         cursor = conn.cursor()
2067:         
2068:         if action == "verify_email":
2069:             cursor.execute(
2070:                 "UPDATE users SET email_verified = TRUE WHERE id = %s",
2071:                 (user_id,)
2072:             )
2073:             conn.commit()
2074:             log_admin_action("verify_email", "user", user_id, {"action": "verified_email"})
2075:             flash("✅ User email verified successfully.", "success")
2076:             
2077:         elif action == "make_admin":
2078:             cursor.execute(
2079:                 "INSERT INTO admin_users (user_id) VALUES (%s) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO NOTHING",
2080:                 (user_id,)
2081:             )
2082:             conn.commit()
2083:             log_admin_action("make_admin", "user", user_id, {"action": "made_admin"})
2084:             flash("✅ User is now an admin.", "success")
2085:             
2086:         elif action == "remove_admin":
2087:             cursor.execute(
2088:                 "DELETE FROM admin_users WHERE user_id = %s",
2089:                 (user_id,)
2090:             )
2091:             conn.commit()
2092:             log_admin_action("remove_admin", "user", user_id, {"action": "removed_admin"})
2093:             flash("✅ Admin privileges removed.", "success")
2094:             
2095:         elif action == "flag_user":
2096:             reason = request.form.get("reason", "No reason provided")
2097:             cursor.execute("""
2098:                 INSERT INTO flagged_users (user_id, flagged_by, reason, status)
2099:                 VALUES (%s, %s, %s, 'pending')
2100:             """, (user_id, session["user_id"], reason))
2101:             conn.commit()
2102:             log_admin_action("flag_user", "user", user_id, {"reason": reason})
2103:             flash("⚠️ User has been flagged for review.", "warning")
2104:             
2105:         elif action == "resolve_flag":
2106:             cursor.execute("""
2107:                 UPDATE flagged_users 
2108:                 SET status = 'resolved', resolved_at = %s, notes = %s
2109:                 WHERE user_id = %s AND status = 'pending'
2110:             """, (datetime.now(timezone.utc), request.form.get("notes", ""), user_id))
2111:             conn.commit()
2112:             log_admin_action("resolve_flag", "user", user_id, {"action": "resolved_flag"})
2113:             flash("✅ Flag resolved.", "success")
2114: 
2115:         elif action == "suspend_user":
2116:             # Cancel their subscription at Flutterwave first
2117:             cancel_success = cancel_flutterwave_subscription_by_user_id(user_id)
2118:             if not cancel_success:
2119:                 flash("⚠️ Could not cancel Flutterwave subscription. Please check manually.", "warning")
2120:             
2121:             # Just mark as suspended, keep all subscription info intact
2122:             cursor.execute("""
2123:                 UPDATE users 
2124:                 SET suspended = TRUE,
2125:                     subscription_status = 'cancelled',
2126:                     flw_subscription_id = NULL
2127:                 WHERE id = %s
2128:             """, (user_id,))
2129:             conn.commit()
2130:             
2131:             log_admin_action("suspend_user", "user", user_id, {"action": "suspended"})
2132:             flash("⚠️ User has been suspended. Their subscription will be reactivated when unsuspended.", "warning")
2133: 
2134:         elif action == "unsuspend_user":
2135:             # Get user info before unsuspending
2136:             cursor.execute(
2137:                 "SELECT subscription_tier, subscription_status, subscription_expiry FROM users WHERE id = %s AND suspended = TRUE",
2138:                 (user_id,)
2139:             )
2140:             user_info = cursor.fetchone()
2141:             
2142:             if user_info:
2143:                 current_tier, current_status, current_expiry = user_info
2144:                 
2145:                 # Check if they have a valid subscription
2146:                 has_valid_subscription = False
2147:                 if current_tier in ['pro', 'vip', 'business']:
2148:                     if current_status in ['active', 'cancelled'] and current_expiry and current_expiry > datetime.now(timezone.utc):
2149:                         has_valid_subscription = True
2150:                     elif current_status in ['active', 'cancelled'] and current_expiry is None:
2151:                         has_valid_subscription = True
2152:                 
2153:                 if has_valid_subscription:
2154:                     # Reactivate the subscription
2155:                     cursor.execute("""
2156:                         UPDATE users 
2157:                         SET suspended = FALSE,
2158:                             subscription_status = 'active',
2159:                             documents_trimmed = FALSE
2160:                         WHERE id = %s
2161:                     """, (user_id,))
2162:                     conn.commit()
2163:                     
2164:                     log_admin_action("unsuspend_user", "user", user_id, {
2165:                         "action": "unsuspended",
2166:                         "subscription_reactivated": True,
2167:                         "tier": current_tier
2168:                     })
2169:                     
2170:                     flash(f"✅ User unsuspended and {current_tier.upper()} subscription reactivated!", "success")
2171:                 else:
2172:                     # No valid subscription - just unsuspend to free
2173:                     cursor.execute("""
2174:                         UPDATE users 
2175:                         SET suspended = FALSE,
2176:                             subscription_tier = 'free',
2177:                             subscription_status = 'active'
2178:                         WHERE id = %s
2179:                     """, (user_id,))
2180:                     conn.commit()
2181:                     
2182:                     log_admin_action("unsuspend_user", "user", user_id, {
2183:                         "action": "unsuspended",
2184:                         "subscription_reactivated": False,
2185:                         "tier": "free"
2186:                     })
2187:                     
2188:                     flash("✅ User unsuspended and set to Free plan. No active subscription found.", "success")
2189:             else:
2190:                 # Fallback - just unsuspend
2191:                 cursor.execute("""
2192:                     UPDATE users 
2193:                     SET suspended = FALSE
2194:                     WHERE id = %s
2195:                 """, (user_id,))
2196:                 conn.commit()
2197:                 log_admin_action("unsuspend_user", "user", user_id, {"action": "unsuspended"})
2198:                 flash("✅ User unsuspended.", "success")
2199: 
2200:         elif action == "upgrade_user":
2201:             new_tier = request.form.get("new_tier")
2202:             duration = request.form.get("duration", "indefinite")
2203:             
2204:             if new_tier not in ['pro']:
2205:                 flash("Invalid tier selected.", "error")
2206:                 return redirect(url_for("admin_user_detail", user_id=user_id))
2207:             
2208:             # Calculate expiry based on duration
2209:             if duration == "indefinite":
2210:                 expiry = None
2211:                 expiry_display = "Indefinite"
2212:             else:
2213:                 duration_map = {
2214:                     '1_month': 30,
2215:                     '3_months': 90,
2216:                     '6_months': 180,
2217:                     '1_year': 365
2218:                 }
2219:                 days = duration_map.get(duration, 30)
2220:                 expiry = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=days)
2221:                 expiry_display = expiry.strftime('%B %d, %Y')
2222:             
2223:             # ✅ Add debug logging
2224:             print(f"🔄 Upgrading user {user_id} to {new_tier} with duration {duration}, expiry: {expiry}")
2225:             
2226:             cursor.execute("""
2227:                 UPDATE users 
2228:                 SET subscription_tier = %s,
2229:                     subscription_status = 'active',
2230:                     subscription_expiry = %s,
2231:                     flw_subscription_id = NULL
2232:                 WHERE id = %s
2233:             """, (new_tier, expiry, user_id))
2234:             conn.commit()
2235:             
2236:             # ✅ Verify the update
2237:             cursor.execute("SELECT subscription_expiry FROM users WHERE id = %s", (user_id,))
2238:             result = cursor.fetchone()

2240:             
2241:             log_admin_action("upgrade_user", "user", user_id, {
2242:                 "new_tier": new_tier, 
2243:                 "duration": duration,
2244:                 "expiry": expiry_display
2245:             })
2246:

2249:         elif action == "downgrade_user":

2251:             if new_tier != 'free':
2252:                 flash("Only free downgrade is supported.", "error")
2253:                 return redirect(url_for("admin_user_detail", user_id=user_id))
2254:             
2255:             # Cancel their subscription first
2256:             cancel_success = cancel_flutterwave_subscription_by_user_id(user_id)

2258:                 flash("⚠️ Could not cancel Flutterwave subscription. Please check manually.", "warning")

2262:

2264:                 UPDATE users

2266:                     subscription_status = 'expired',
2267:                     subscription_expiry = NULL,
2268:                     flw_subscription_id = NULL
2269:                 WHERE id = %s
2270:             """, (user_id,))

2274: 
2275:         elif action == "force_fix":
2276:             # Force a subscription check and cleanup
2277:             sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
2278:             tier = sub_status['tier']
2279:             
2280:             # Check if subscription expired or we need to downgrade
2281:             if tier != 'free' and tier != 'suspended' and not sub_status['is_active']:
2282:                 # Cancel the subscription
2283:                 cancel_success = cancel_flutterwave_subscription_by_user_id(user_id)

2289:                     UPDATE users

2291:                         subscription_status = 'expired',
2292:                         subscription_expiry = NULL,
2293:                         flw_subscription_id = NULL
2294:                     WHERE id = %s
2295:                 """, (user_id,))
2296:                 conn.commit()
2297:                 flash(f"✅ User forced to Free plan. Removed {deleted_count} documents. Subscription cancelled.", "success")
2298:             else:
2299:                 # Just check and trim if over limit on free
2300:                 cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents WHERE user_id = %s", (user_id,))
2301:                 doc_count = cursor.fetchone()[0]
2302:                 if tier == 'free' and doc_count > 20:
2303:                     deleted_count = trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
2304:                     flash(f"⚠️ User had {doc_count} documents on Free plan. Removed {deleted_count} documents.", "warning")
2305:                 else:
2306:                     flash(f"✅ User is on {tier} plan with {doc_count} documents. No issues found.", "success")
2307:             
2308:             log_admin_action("force_fix", "user", user_id, {"action": "force_fix_subscription"})
2309: 
2310:         elif action == "delete_user":
2311:             # FIRST: Cancel their subscription at Flutterwave
2312:             cancel_success = cancel_flutterwave_subscription_by_user_id(user_id)
2313:             if not cancel_success:
2314:                 flash("⚠️ Could not cancel Flutterwave subscription. Please check manually.", "warning")
2315:             
2316:             # Delete user and all their data
2317:             cursor.execute("DELETE FROM documents WHERE user_id = %s", (user_id,))
2318:             cursor.execute("DELETE FROM flagged_users WHERE user_id = %s", (user_id,))
2319:             cursor.execute("DELETE FROM admin_users WHERE user_id = %s", (user_id,))
2320:             cursor.execute("DELETE FROM users WHERE id = %s", (user_id,))
2321:             conn.commit()
2322:             log_admin_action("delete_user", "user", user_id, {"action": "deleted_user"})
2323:             flash("🗑️ User and all associated data deleted. Subscription cancelled.", "warning")
2324:             return redirect(url_for("admin_users"))
2325: 
2326:         cursor.close()
2327:         
2328:     except Exception as e:
2329:         conn.rollback()
2330:         flash(f"Error performing action: {str(e)}", "error")
2331:     finally:
2332:         put_db(conn)
2333:     
2334:     return redirect(url_for("admin_user_detail", user_id=user_id))

2336: @app.route("/admin/inquiries")
2337: def admin_inquiries():
2338:     """View all contact inquiries."""
2339:     auth = require_admin()
2340:     if auth:
2341:         return auth
2342:     
2343:     status_filter = request.args.get("status", "all")
2344:     
2345:     conn = get_db()
2346:     try:
2347:         cursor = conn.cursor()
2348:         
2349:         query = """
2350:             SELECT id, name, email, subject, message, inquiry_type, status, created_at
2351:             FROM contact_inquiries
2352:         """
2353:         params = []
2354:         
2355:         if status_filter != "all":
2356:             query += " WHERE status = %s"

2363:         cursor.close()
2364:         
2365:     finally:
2366:         put_db(conn)

2439: @app.route("/admin/documents")
2440: def admin_documents():
2441:     """View all documents across all users, grouped by user."""
2442:     auth = require_admin()
2443:     if auth:
2444:         return auth
2445:     
2446:     conn = get_db()
2447:     try:
2448:         cursor = conn.cursor()
2449:         cursor.execute("""
2450:             SELECT d.id, d.title, d.expiry_date, d.user_id, u.email
2451:             FROM documents d
2452:             JOIN users u ON u.id = d.user_id
2453:             ORDER BY u.email ASC, d.expiry_date ASC
2454:             LIMIT 100
2455:         """)
2456:         raw_documents = cursor.fetchall()
2457:         cursor.close()
2458:         
2459:         # Process documents through get_status() for consistency
2460:         documents = []
2461:         for doc_id, title, expiry_date, user_id, email in raw_documents:
2462:             days_left, status, color, icon = get_status(expiry_date)
2463:             documents.append({
2464:                 'id': doc_id,
2465:                 'title': title,
2466:                 'expiry_date': expiry_date,
2467:                 'user_id': user_id,
2468:                 'email': email,
2469:                 'days_left': days_left,
2470:                 'status': status,
2471:                 'color': color,
2472:                 'icon': icon
2473:             })
2474:         
2475:     finally:
2476:         put_db(conn)
2477:     
2478:     return render_template("admin/documents.html", documents=documents)

2504: @app.route("/admin/fix-user/<int:user_id>")
2505: def admin_fix_user(user_id):
2506:     """Force a subscription check and cleanup for a user."""
2507:     auth = require_admin()
2508:     if auth:
2509:         return auth
2510:     
2511:     # Check if user exists
2512:     conn = get_db()
2513:     try:
2514:         cursor = conn.cursor()
2515:         cursor.execute("SELECT email FROM users WHERE id = %s", (user_id,))
2516:         user = cursor.fetchone()
2517:         if not user:
2518:             flash("User not found.", "error")
2519:             return redirect(url_for("admin_users"))
2520:         
2521:         # Force subscription check
2522:         sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
2523:         tier = sub_status['tier']
2524:         
2525:         if tier != 'free' and tier != 'suspended' and not sub_status['is_active']:
2526:             deleted_count = trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
2527:             cursor.execute("""
2528:                 UPDATE users 
2529:                 SET subscription_tier = 'free', 
2530:                     subscription_status = 'expired',
2531:                     subscription_expiry = NULL
2532:                 WHERE id = %s
2533:             """, (user_id,))
2534:             conn.commit()
2535:             flash(f"✅ User {user[0]} downgraded to Free. Removed {deleted_count} documents.", "success")
2536:         else:
2537:             # Just check and trim if over limit
2538:             cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents WHERE user_id = %s", (user_id,))
2539:             doc_count = cursor.fetchone()[0]
2540:             if tier == 'free' and doc_count > 20:
2541:                 deleted_count = trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
2542:                 flash(f"⚠️ User had {doc_count} documents on Free plan. Removed {deleted_count} documents.", "warning")
2543:             else:
2544:                 flash(f"✅ User {user[0]} is on {tier} plan with {doc_count} documents. No changes needed.", "success")
2545:         
2546:         cursor.close()
2547:     finally:
2548:         put_db(conn)
2549:     
2550:     return redirect(url_for("admin_user_detail", user_id=user_id))

2619: @app.route("/admin/user/<int:user_id>/document/<int:doc_id>/delete", methods=["POST"])
2620: def admin_delete_user_document(user_id, doc_id):
2621:     """Delete a document on behalf of a user."""
2622:     auth = require_admin()
2623:     if auth:
2624:         return auth
2625:     
2626:     conn = get_db()
2627:     try:
2628:         cursor = conn.cursor()
2629:         
2630:         # Verify document belongs to user
2631:         cursor.execute(
2632:             "SELECT title FROM documents WHERE id = %s AND user_id = %s",
2633:             (doc_id, user_id)
2634:         )
2635:         doc = cursor.fetchone()
2636:         if not doc:
2637:             flash("Document not found or doesn't belong to this user.", "error")
2638:             return redirect(url_for("admin_user_documents", user_id=user_id))
2639:         
2640:         # Delete the document
2641:         cursor.execute(
2642:             "DELETE FROM documents WHERE id = %s AND user_id = %s",
2643:             (doc_id, user_id)
2644:         )
2645:         conn.commit()
2646:         
2647:         log_admin_action("admin_delete_document", "document", doc_id, {"user_id": user_id, "title": doc[0]})
2648:         flash(f"✅ Document '{doc[0]}' deleted successfully.", "success")
2649:         
2650:     except Exception as e:
2651:         conn.rollback()
2652:         flash(f"Error deleting document: {str(e)}", "error")
2653:     finally:
2654:         put_db(conn)
2655:     
2656:     return redirect(url_for("admin_user_documents", user_id=user_id))

2659: @app.route("/admin/user/<int:user_id>/document/<int:doc_id>/renew", methods=["GET", "POST"])
2660: def admin_renew_user_document(user_id, doc_id):
2661:     """Renew a document on behalf of a user."""
2662:     auth = require_admin()
2663:     if auth:
2664:         return auth
2665:     
2666:     conn = get_db()
2667:     try:
2668:         cursor = conn.cursor()
2669:         
2670:         # Get document info
2671:         cursor.execute(
2672:             "SELECT title, expiry_date FROM documents WHERE id = %s AND user_id = %s",
2673:             (doc_id, user_id)
2674:         )
2675:         doc = cursor.fetchone()
2676:         if not doc:
2677:             flash("Document not found or doesn't belong to this user.", "error")
2678:             return redirect(url_for("admin_user_documents", user_id=user_id))
2679:         
2680:         if request.method == "POST":
2681:             new_expiry = request.form.get("expiry_date")
2682:             
2683:             if not new_expiry:
2684:                 flash("Please select a new expiry date.", "error")
2685:                 return redirect(url_for("admin_renew_user_document", user_id=user_id, doc_id=doc_id))
2686:             
2687:             try:
2688:                 datetime.strptime(new_expiry, "%Y-%m-%d")
2689:             except ValueError:
2690:                 flash("Invalid date format.", "error")
2691:                 return redirect(url_for("admin_renew_user_document", user_id=user_id, doc_id=doc_id))
2692:             
2693:             cursor.execute("""
2694:                 UPDATE documents 
2695:                 SET expiry_date = %s, 
2696:                     last_reminder_sent = NULL, 
2697:                     reminder_state = NULL, 
2698:                     snoozed_until = NULL 
2699:                 WHERE id = %s AND user_id = %s
2700:             """, (new_expiry, doc_id, user_id))
2701:             conn.commit()
2702:             
2703:             log_admin_action("admin_renew_document", "document", doc_id, {"user_id": user_id, "new_expiry": new_expiry})
2704:             flash(f"✅ Document '{doc[0]}' renewed successfully to {new_expiry}.", "success")
2705:             return redirect(url_for("admin_user_documents", user_id=user_id))
2706:         
2707:         cursor.close()
2708:         
2709:     finally:
2710:         put_db(conn)
2711:     
2712:     return render_template(
2713:         "admin/renew_documents.html",
2714:         user_id=user_id,
2715:         doc_id=doc_id,
2716:         doc=doc
2717:     )

2722: @app.route("/admin/reset-test-account", methods=["POST"])
2723: @limiter.limit("5 per hour", error_message="Too many reset attempts. Please wait.")
2724: def admin_reset_test_account():
2725:     """Admin-only endpoint to reset a test account."""
2726:     auth = require_admin()
2727:     if auth:
2728:         return auth
2729:     
2730:     email = request.form.get("email", "").strip().lower()
2731:     
2732:     if not email:
2733:         flash("Please provide an email address.", "error")
2734:         return redirect(url_for("admin_users"))
2735:     
2736:     # Security: Only allow resetting the configured test account
2737:     if ALLOWED_TEST_EMAIL:
2738:         if email != ALLOWED_TEST_EMAIL.lower():
2739:             flash(f"Only the configured test account can be reset.", "error")
2740:             return redirect(url_for("admin_users"))
2741:     else:
2742:         if email != 'test@fritt.org':
2743:             flash("Only test accounts can be reset. Set TEST_EMAIL env variable to configure.", "error")
2744:             return redirect(url_for("admin_users"))
2745:     
2746:     conn = get_db()
2747:     try:
2748:         cursor = conn.cursor()
2749:         
2750:         cursor.execute(
2751:             "SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE email = %s",
2752:             (email,)
2753:         )
2754:         user = cursor.fetchone()
2755:         
2756:         if not user:
2757:             flash(f"User with email '{email}' not found.", "error")
2758:             return redirect(url_for("admin_users"))
2759:         
2760:         user_id = user[0]
2761:         
2762:         cursor.execute(
2763:             "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents WHERE user_id = %s",
2764:             (user_id,)
2765:         )
2766:         doc_count = cursor.fetchone()[0]
2767:

2769:         deleted_docs = cursor.rowcount
2770:         
2771:         cursor.execute("DELETE FROM user_activity_logs WHERE user_id = %s", (user_id,))
2772:         cursor.execute("DELETE FROM flagged_users WHERE user_id = %s", (user_id,))
2773:         
2774:         cursor.execute("""
2775:             UPDATE users 
2776:             SET 
2777:                 email_verified = FALSE,
2778:                 reset_token = NULL,
2779:                 reset_token_expiry = NULL,
2780:                 verification_token = NULL,
2781:                 verification_token_expiry = NULL,
2782:                 email_verification_sent_at = NULL,
2783:                 subscription_tier = 'free',
2784:                 subscription_status = 'active',
2785:                 subscription_expiry = NULL,
2786:                 flw_subscription_id = NULL,
2787:                 documents_trimmed = FALSE,
2788:                 trial_used = FALSE,
2789:                 trial_ends_at = NULL,
2790:                 suspended = FALSE
2791:             WHERE id = %s
2792:             RETURNING email
2793:         """, (user_id,))
2794:         
2795:         updated_user = cursor.fetchone()
2796:         conn.commit()
2797:         
2798:         log_admin_action("reset_test_account", "user", user_id, {
2799:             "email": email,
2800:             "documents_deleted": deleted_docs,
2801:             "previous_doc_count": doc_count
2802:         })
2803:         
2804:         flash(
2805:             f"✅ Account {email} reset successfully! Deleted {deleted_docs} documents. "
2806:             "Account is now unverified, on free tier, with no documents.",
2807:             "success"
2808:         )
2809:         
2810:     except Exception as e:
2811:         conn.rollback()
2812:         print(f"❌ Error resetting account: {e}")

2878: @app.route("/register", methods=["GET", "POST"])
2879: @limiter.limit("5 per hour", error_message="Too many registration attempts. Please try again later.")
2880: def register():
2881:     """User registration."""
2882:     error = None
2883:     if request.method == "POST":
2884:         email = request.form["email"].strip().lower()
2885:         password = request.form["password"]
2886: 
2887:         password_errors = validate_password_strength(password)
2888:         if password_errors:
2889:             error = f"Password must contain: {', '.join(password_errors)}"
2890:         else:
2891:             conn = get_db()
2892:             try:
2893:                 cursor = conn.cursor()
2894:                 cursor.execute("SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = %s", (email,))
2895:                 if cursor.fetchone():
2896:                     error = "An account with that email already exists"
2897:                 else:
2898:                     password_hash = generate_password_hash(password)
2899:                     cursor.execute(
2900:                         "INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, email_verified) VALUES (%s, %s, %s) RETURNING id",
2901:                         (email, password_hash, False)
2902:                     )
2903:                     new_user_id = cursor.fetchone()[0]
2904:                     conn.commit()
2905: 
2906:                     # Send verification email
2907:                     send_verification_email(email, new_user_id)
2908:                     
2909:                     # ⭐ LOG THE USER IN IMMEDIATELY (but they're not verified yet)
2910:                     session["user_id"] = new_user_id
2911:                     session["email"] = email
2912:                     
2913:                     cursor.close()
2914:             finally:
2915:                 put_db(conn)
2916: 
2917:             if not error:
2918:                 flash("✅ Account created! Please check your email to verify your address.", "success")
2919:                 return redirect(url_for("request_verification"))  # Redirect to verification page
2920: 
2921:     return render_template("register.html", error=error)
2922: 
2923: @app.route("/verify-email/<token>")
2924: def verify_email(token):
2925:     """Verify a user's email address."""
2926:     conn = get_db()
2927:     try:
2928:         cursor = conn.cursor()
2929:         cursor.execute(
2930:             "SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE verification_token = %s AND verification_token_expiry > %s AND email_verified = FALSE",
2931:             (token, datetime.now(timezone.utc))
2932:         )
2933:         user = cursor.fetchone()
2934:         
2935:         if user:
2936:             user_id, email = user
2937:             cursor.execute(
2938:                 "UPDATE users SET email_verified = TRUE, verification_token = NULL, verification_token_expiry = NULL WHERE id = %s",
2939:                 (user_id,)
2940:             )
2941:             conn.commit()
2942:             
2943:             # ⭐ LOG THE USER IN AUTOMATICALLY
2944:             session["user_id"] = user_id
2945:             session["email"] = email
2946:             
2947:             # Send welcome email (optional - do this in background or don't block)
2948:             # send_welcome_email(email, user_id)
2949:             
2950:             flash("✅ Email verified successfully! Welcome to Fritt Tracker.", "success")
2951:             return redirect("/")
2952:         else:
2953:             cursor.execute(
2954:                 "SELECT id, email_verified FROM users WHERE verification_token = %s",
2955:                 (token,)
2956:             )
2957:             expired_user = cursor.fetchone()
2958:             
2959:             if expired_user and expired_user[1]:
2960:                 flash("ℹ️ This email is already verified. Please log in.", "info")
2961:                 return redirect(url_for("login"))
2962:             else:
2963:                 flash("❌ This verification link has expired or is invalid. Please request a new one.", "error")
2964:                 return render_template("verify_email.html", invalid=True)
2965:         cursor.close()
2966:     finally:
2967:         put_db(conn)
2968:

2976: @app.route("/request-verification", methods=["GET", "POST"])
2977: @limiter.limit("3 per hour", error_message="Too many verification requests. Please wait an hour.")

3360: @app.route("/bulk-delete", methods=["POST"])
3361: @limiter.limit(lambda: "3 per day" if session.get('user_id') and get_user_tier(session.get('user_id')) in ['free'] else "10 per day")
3362: def bulk_delete_documents():
3363:     """Delete multiple documents at once with safety confirmations."""
3364:     auth = require_verified()
3365:     if auth:
3366:         return auth
3367:     
3368:     user_id = session["user_id"]
3369:     
3370:     # Get subscription tier for limits
3371:     sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
3372:     tier = sub_status['tier']
3373:     
3374:     # Get document IDs from form
3375:     doc_ids = request.form.getlist("document_ids")
3376:     
3377:     if not doc_ids:
3378:         flash("No documents selected for deletion.", "error")
3379:         return redirect("/")
3380:     
3381:     # Limit check based on tier
3382:     MAX_BULK_DELETE = {
3383:         'free': 5,
3384:         'pro': 50,
3385:         'vip': 999,  # Essentially unlimited
3386:         'business': 999
3387:     }
3388:     
3389:     max_allowed = MAX_BULK_DELETE.get(tier, 5)
3390:     if len(doc_ids) > max_allowed:
3391:         flash(f"⚠️ You can only delete {max_allowed} documents at a time on the {tier.capitalize()} plan. Upgrade to delete more at once.", "warning")
3392:         return redirect("/")
3393:     
3394:     # Verify all documents belong to the user
3395:     conn = get_db()
3396:     try:
3397:         cursor = conn.cursor()
3398:         
3399:         # Get the actual document titles for the confirmation message
3400:         placeholders = ','.join(['%s'] * len(doc_ids))
3401:         cursor.execute(
3402:             f"SELECT id, title FROM documents WHERE id IN ({placeholders}) AND user_id = %s",
3403:             doc_ids + [user_id]
3404:         )
3405:         docs_to_delete = cursor.fetchall()
3406:         
3407:         # Check if any IDs were invalid (belonged to someone else)
3408:         if len(docs_to_delete) != len(doc_ids):
3409:             flash("Some documents could not be found or don't belong to you.", "error")
3410:             return redirect("/")
3411:         
3412:         # Get titles for flash message
3413:         titles = [doc[1] for doc in docs_to_delete]
3414:         doc_ids_to_delete = [str(doc[0]) for doc in docs_to_delete]
3415:         
3416:         # Delete the documents
3417:         placeholders = ','.join(['%s'] * len(doc_ids_to_delete))
3418:         cursor.execute(
3419:             f"DELETE FROM documents WHERE id IN ({placeholders}) AND user_id = %s",
3420:             doc_ids_to_delete + [user_id]
3421:         )
3422:         deleted_count = cursor.rowcount
3423:         conn.commit()
3424:         
3425:         if deleted_count > 0:
3426:             # Log the bulk deletion
3427:             log_user_action(user_id, "bulk_delete_documents", {
3428:                 "count": deleted_count,
3429:                 "titles": titles[:5],  # Only store first 5 to avoid huge logs
3430:                 "total": len(titles),
3431:                 "tier": tier
3432:             })
3433:             
3434:             if deleted_count == 1:
3435:                 flash(f"✅ Document '{titles[0]}' deleted successfully.", "success")
3436:             else:
3437:                 flash(f"✅ {deleted_count} documents deleted successfully.", "success")
3438:         else:
3439:             flash("No documents were deleted.", "warning")
3440:             
3441:         cursor.close()
3442:         
3443:     except Exception as e:
3444:         conn.rollback()
3445:         print(f"❌ Bulk delete error: {e}")
3446:         flash("An error occurred while deleting documents. Please try again.", "error")
3447:     finally:
3448:         put_db(conn)
3449:     
3450:     return redirect("/")

3504: @app.route("/import-csv", methods=["GET", "POST"])
3505: @limiter.limit(lambda: "20 per day" if session.get('user_id') and get_user_tier(session['user_id']) == 'vip' else "5 per day")
3506: def import_csv():
3507:     """Import documents from CSV file."""
3508:     auth = require_verified()
3509:     if auth:
3510:         return auth
3511:     
3512:     user_id = session["user_id"]
3513:     
3514:     # Check if user is on a paid plan
3515:     sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
3516:     tier = sub_status['tier']
3517:     
3518:     # Only Pro, VIP, and Business can import CSV
3519:     if tier not in ['pro', 'vip', 'business']:
3520:         flash("📥 CSV import is a Pro feature. Upgrade to import multiple documents at once!", "warning")
3521:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
3522: 
3523:     error = None
3524: 
3525:     if request.method == "POST":
3526:         if 'csv_file' not in request.files:
3527:             error = "Please upload a CSV file."
3528:         else:
3529:             file = request.files['csv_file']
3530:             
3531:             if file.filename == '':
3532:                 error = "No file selected."
3533:             elif not file.filename.lower().endswith('.csv'):
3534:                 error = "Please upload a CSV file (.csv)."
3535:             else:
3536:                 try:
3537:                     stream = io.StringIO(file.stream.read().decode("UTF-8"), newline=None)
3538:                     csv_input = csv.reader(stream)
3539:                     
3540:                     headers = [h.strip().lower().replace(' ', '_') for h in next(csv_input)]
3541:                     
3542:                     title_match = None
3543:                     expiry_match = None
3544:                     
3545:                     for i, h in enumerate(headers):
3546:                         if h in ['title', 'document', 'document_title', 'doc_title', 'name']:
3547:                             title_match = i
3548:                         if h in ['expiry_date', 'expiry', 'expiration', 'expiration_date']:
3549:                             expiry_match = i
3550:                     
3551:                     if title_match is None:
3552:                         error = f"CSV must have a 'title' column. Found: {', '.join(headers)}"
3553:                     elif expiry_match is None:
3554:                         error = f"CSV must have an 'expiry_date' column. Found: {', '.join(headers)}"
3555:                     else:
3556:                         conn = get_db()
3557:                         cursor = conn.cursor()
3558:                         added = 0
3559:                         failed = 0
3560:                         
3561:                         for row in csv_input:
3562:                             if not row or all(cell.strip() == '' for cell in row):
3563:                                 continue
3564:                             
3565:                             title = row[title_match].strip() if len(row) > title_match else ""
3566:                             expiry_date = row[expiry_match].strip() if len(row) > expiry_match else ""
3567:                             
3568:                             if not title or not expiry_date:
3569:                                 failed += 1
3570:                                 continue
3571:                             
3572:                             try:
3573:                                 datetime.strptime(expiry_date, "%Y-%m-%d")
3574:                             except ValueError:
3575:                                 try:
3576:                                     parsed = datetime.strptime(expiry_date, "%d/%m/%Y")
3577:                                     expiry_date = parsed.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
3578:                                 except ValueError:
3579:                                     try:
3580:                                         parsed = datetime.strptime(expiry_date, "%m/%d/%Y")
3581:                                         expiry_date = parsed.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
3582:                                     except ValueError:
3583:                                         failed += 1
3584:                                         continue
3585:                             
3586:                             try:
3587:                                 cursor.execute(
3588:                                     "INSERT INTO documents (title, expiry_date, user_id) VALUES (%s, %s, %s)",
3589:                                     (title, expiry_date, session["user_id"])
3590:                                 )
3591:                                 added += 1
3592:                             except Exception:
3593:                                 failed += 1
3594:                         
3595:                         conn.commit()
3596:                         cursor.close()
3597:                         put_db(conn)
3598:                         
3599:                         if added > 0:
3600:                             flash(f"✅ Successfully imported {added} documents! {failed} failed.", "success")
3601:                         else:
3602:                             flash(f"⚠️ No documents imported. {failed} rows had errors.", "error")
3603:                             
3604:                         return redirect("/")
3605:                         
3606:                 except csv.Error as e:
3607:                     error = f"CSV error: {str(e)}"
3608:                 except Exception as e:
3609:                     error = f"Error reading file: {str(e)}"
3610: 
3611:     return render_template("import_csv.html", error=error)
3612:

3720: def cancel_flutterwave_subscription(flw_subscription_id):
3721:     """
3722:     Cancel a subscription at Flutterwave.
3723:     Returns True if successful, False otherwise.
3724:     """
3725:     if not flw_subscription_id:
3726:         print("⚠️ No Flutterwave subscription ID to cancel")
3727:         return True  # No subscription to cancel
3728:     
3729:     try:
3730:         response = requests.put(
3731:             f'https://api.flutterwave.com/v3/subscriptions/{flw_subscription_id}/cancel',
3732:             headers={
3733:                 'Authorization': f'Bearer {os.getenv("FLW_SECRET_KEY")}',
3734:                 'Content-Type': 'application/json'
3735:             },
3736:             timeout=30
3737:         )
3738:         
3739:         if response.status_code == 200:
3740:             data = response.json()
3741:             if data.get('status') == 'success':
3742:                 print(f"✅ Flutterwave subscription {flw_subscription_id} cancelled")
3743:                 return True
3744:             else:
3745:                 print(f"❌ Flutterwave cancellation failed: {data.get('message', 'Unknown error')}")
3746:                 return False
3747:         else:
3748:             print(f"❌ HTTP error cancelling subscription: {response.status_code}")
3749:             return False
3750:     except Exception as e:
3751:         print(f"❌ Error cancelling Flutterwave subscription: {e}")
3752:         return False

3755: @app.route("/cancel-subscription", methods=["POST"])
3756: @limiter.limit("5 per hour", error_message="Too many cancellation attempts. Please wait.")
3757: def cancel_subscription():
3758:     """Cancel user's subscription."""
3759:     auth = require_verified()
3760:     if auth:
3761:         return auth
3762:     
3763:     user_id = session["user_id"]
3764:     sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
3765:     
3766:     if sub_status['tier'] == 'free':
3767:         flash("You're already on the Free plan.", "info")
3768:         return redirect(url_for("home"))
3769:     
3770:     # Get current expiry and Flutterwave subscription ID before cancelling
3771:     current_expiry = sub_status.get('expiry')
3772:     flw_subscription_id = sub_status.get('flw_subscription_id')
3773:     
3774:     conn = get_db()
3775:     try:
3776:         cursor = conn.cursor()
3777:         
3778:         # FIRST: Cancel at Flutterwave
3779:         if flw_subscription_id:
3780:             cancel_success = cancel_flutterwave_subscription_by_user_id(user_id)
3781:             if not cancel_success:
3782:                 flash("Could not cancel subscription at Flutterwave. Please contact support.", "error")
3783:                 return redirect(url_for("home"))
3784:         
3785:         # SECOND: Update our database
3786:         if current_expiry and current_expiry > datetime.now(timezone.utc):
3787:             # Keep access until expiry, just mark as cancelled
3788:             cursor.execute("""
3789:                 UPDATE users 
3790:                 SET subscription_status = 'cancelled',
3791:                     flw_subscription_id = NULL
3792:                 WHERE id = %s
3793:             """, (user_id,))
3794:             conn.commit()
3795:             
3796:             days_left = (current_expiry - datetime.now(timezone.utc)).days
3797:             flash(f"✅ Your subscription has been cancelled. You'll have {sub_status['tier'].upper()} access until {current_expiry.strftime('%B %d, %Y')} ({days_left} days remaining).", "success")
3798:         else:
3799:             # If no expiry or already expired, downgrade immediately
3800:             cursor.execute("""
3801:                 UPDATE users 
3802:                 SET subscription_tier = 'free',
3803:                     subscription_status = 'cancelled',
3804:                     subscription_expiry = NULL,
3805:                     flw_subscription_id = NULL
3806:                 WHERE id = %s
3807:             """, (user_id,))
3808:             conn.commit()
3809:             flash("✅ Your subscription has been cancelled. You're now on the Free plan.", "success")
3810:         
3811:         cursor.close()
3812:         
3813:     except Exception as e:
3814:         print(f"❌ Error cancelling subscription: {e}")
3815:         conn.rollback()
3816:         flash("Something went wrong. Please try again.", "error")
3817:     finally:
3818:         put_db(conn)
3819:     
3820:     return redirect(url_for("home"))

3822: @app.route("/reactivate-subscription", methods=["POST"])
3823: @limiter.limit("5 per hour", error_message="Too many reactivation attempts. Please wait.")
3824: def reactivate_subscription():
3825:     """Reactivate a cancelled subscription."""
3826:     auth = require_verified()
3827:     if auth:
3828:         return auth
3829:     
3830:     user_id = session["user_id"]
3831:     sub_status = get_subscription_status(user_id)
3832:     
3833:     tier = sub_status['tier']
3834:     status = sub_status['status']
3835:     current_expiry = sub_status.get('expiry')
3836:     documents_trimmed = sub_status.get('documents_trimmed', False)
3837:     
3838:     # CASE 1: Already active → Just inform user
3839:     if status == 'active':
3840:         flash("Your subscription is already active.", "info")
3841:         return redirect(url_for("home"))
3842:     
3843:     # CASE 2: On free plan (documents trimmed) → Can't reactivate
3844:     if tier == 'free' or documents_trimmed:
3845:         flash("Your subscription has expired. Please purchase a new subscription.", "warning")
3846:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
3847:     
3848:     # CASE 3: Admin-upgraded with no expiry → Reactivate immediately!
3849:     if current_expiry is None:
3850:         conn = get_db()
3851:         try:
3852:             cursor = conn.cursor()
3853:             cursor.execute("""
3854:                 UPDATE users 
3855:                 SET subscription_status = 'active'
3856:                 WHERE id = %s
3857:             """, (user_id,))
3858:             conn.commit()
3859:             cursor.close()
3860:             flash(f"✅ Your {tier.upper()} subscription has been reactivated!", "success")
3861:             return redirect(url_for("home"))
3862:         except Exception as e:
3863:             print(f"❌ Error reactivating: {e}")
3864:             conn.rollback()
3865:             flash("Something went wrong. Please try again.", "error")
3866:             return redirect(url_for("home"))
3867:     
3868:     # CASE 4: Has expiry and is still valid → Reactivate!
3869:     if current_expiry > datetime.now(timezone.utc):
3870:         conn = get_db()
3871:         try:
3872:             cursor = conn.cursor()
3873:             cursor.execute("""
3874:                 UPDATE users 
3875:                 SET subscription_status = 'active'
3876:                 WHERE id = %s
3877:             """, (user_id,))
3878:             conn.commit()
3879:             cursor.close()
3880:             
3881:             days_left = (current_expiry - datetime.now(timezone.utc)).days
3882:             flash(f"✅ Your {tier.upper()} subscription has been reactivated! Access until {current_expiry.strftime('%B %d, %Y')} ({days_left} days remaining).", "success")
3883:             return redirect(url_for("home"))
3884:         except Exception as e:
3885:             print(f"❌ Error reactivating: {e}")
3886:             conn.rollback()
3887:             flash("Something went wrong. Please try again.", "error")
3888:             return redirect(url_for("home"))
3889:     
3890:     # CASE 5: Expired - Can't reactivate
3891:     flash("Your subscription has expired. Please purchase a new subscription.", "warning")
3892:     return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
