3894: @app.route("/payment/initiate", methods=["POST"])
3895: @limiter.limit("5 per hour", error_message="Too many payment initiations. Please wait before trying again.")
3896: def initiate_payment():
3897:     """Initialize Flutterwave payment."""
3898:     auth = require_verified()
3899:     if auth:
3900:         return auth
3901:     
3902:     plan_id = request.form.get("plan_id")
3903:     plan_type = request.form.get("plan_type")
3904:     
3905:     if not plan_id or not plan_type:
3906:         flash("Invalid payment request.", "error")
3907:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
3908:     
3909:     region = get_user_region()
3910:     currency = get_currency_for_region(region)
3911:     pricing = get_pricing(region)
3912:     
3913:     amount_map = {
3914:         'pro_monthly': pricing['monthly_raw'],
3915:         'pro_yearly': pricing['yearly_raw'],
3916:         'vip_monthly': pricing['vip_monthly_raw'],
3917:         'vip_yearly': pricing['vip_yearly_raw'],
3918:     }
3919:     
3920:     amount = amount_map.get(plan_type, 0)
3921:     if amount <= 0:
3922:         flash("Invalid payment amount.", "error")
3923:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
3924:     
3925:     try:
3926:         base_url = os.environ.get("APP_URL", "tracker.fritt.org")
3927:         redirect_url = f"https://{base_url}{url_for('payment_callback')}"
3928:         
3929:         tx_ref = f"fritt_{session['user_id']}_{int(time.time())}"
3930:         
3931:         payload = {
3932:             'amount': str(amount),
3933:             'currency': currency,
3934:             'tx_ref': tx_ref,
3935:             'payment_plan': int(plan_id),
3936:             'redirect_url': redirect_url,
3937:             'customer': {
3938:                 'email': session['email'],
3939:                 'name': session.get('email', 'Customer').split('@')[0],
3940:             },
3941:             'meta': {
3942:                 'user_id': session['user_id'],
3943:                 'plan_type': plan_type,
3944:                 'region': region
3945:             },
3946:             'payment_options': 'card,banktransfer,ussd,mobilemoney,qr',  # Still works with payment_plan
3947:         }
3948:         
3949:         print(f"🔍 Sending payment request: {payload}")
3950:         
3951:         # Use test or live endpoint
3952:         api_base = "https://api.flutterwave.com/v3"
3953:         if is_test_mode():
3954:             print("🔧 Running in TEST MODE")
3955:         else:
3956:             print("🚀 Running in LIVE MODE")
3957: 
3958:         response = requests.post(
3959:             f'{api_base}/payments',
3960:             headers={
3961:                 'Authorization': f'Bearer {os.getenv("FLW_SECRET_KEY")}',
3962:                 'Content-Type': 'application/json'
3963:             },
3964:             json=payload,
3965:             timeout=30
3966:         )
3967:         
3968:         print(f"📨 Flutterwave response status: {response.status_code}")
3969:         print(f"📨 Flutterwave response: {response.text[:500]}...")
3970:         
3971:         if response.status_code == 200:
3972:             data = response.json()
3973:             if data.get('status') == 'success':
3974:                 session['tx_ref'] = tx_ref
3975:                 
3976:                 link = data['data'].get('link')
3977:                 if link:
3978:                     return redirect(link)
3979:                 else:
3980:                     flash("Payment link not found.", "error")
3981:                     return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
3982:             else:
3983:                 error_message = data.get('message', 'Unknown error')
3984:                 print(f"❌ Flutterwave error: {error_message}")
3985:                 flash(f"Payment initialization failed: {error_message}", "error")
3986:                 return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
3987:         else:
3988:             print(f"❌ HTTP Error: {response.status_code}")
3989:             print(f"❌ Response: {response.text}")
3990:             flash("Payment initialization failed. Please try again.", "error")
3991:             return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
3992:         
3993:     except Exception as e:
3994:         print(f"❌ Payment error: {e}")
3995:         import traceback
3996:         traceback.print_exc()
3997:         flash("Payment initialization failed. Please try again.", "error")
3998:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))

4001: @app.route("/payment/callback")
4002: @limiter.exempt
4003: def payment_callback():
4004:     """Handle payment callback from Flutterwave."""
4005:     auth = require_verified()
4006:     if auth:
4007:         return auth
4008:     
4009:     tx_ref = request.args.get('tx_ref')
4010:     transaction_id = request.args.get('transaction_id')
4011:     
4012:     if not tx_ref or not transaction_id:
4013:         flash("Invalid payment callback.", "error")
4014:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4015:     
4016:     try:
4017:         # Check if we're in test mode vs live mode
4018:         is_test_mode = os.environ.get("FLW_TEST_MODE", "false").lower() == "true"
4019:         
4020:         response = requests.get(
4021:             f'https://api.flutterwave.com/v3/transactions/{transaction_id}/verify',
4022:             headers={
4023:                 'Authorization': f'Bearer {os.getenv("FLW_SECRET_KEY")}',
4024:                 'Content-Type': 'application/json'
4025:             },
4026:             timeout=30
4027:         )
4028:         
4029:         if response.status_code == 200:
4030:             data = response.json()
4031:             
4032:             if data.get('status') == 'success' and data['data']['status'] == 'successful':
4033:                 # Skip test mode transactions in production
4034:                 if data['data'].get('test_mode', False) and not is_test_mode:
4035:                     flash("Test payments are not allowed in production.", "error")
4036:                     return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4037:                 
4038:                 user_id = session['user_id']
4039:                 
4040:                 meta = data['data'].get('meta', {})
4041:                 plan_type = meta.get('plan_type', '')
4042:                 
4043:                 if not plan_type:
4044:                     payment_plan = data['data'].get('payment_plan', {})
4045:                     plan_name = payment_plan.get('name', '')
4046:                     if 'Pro' in plan_name:
4047:                         plan_type = 'pro_monthly' if 'Monthly' in plan_name else 'pro_yearly'
4048:                     elif 'VIP' in plan_name:
4049:                         plan_type = 'vip_monthly' if 'Monthly' in plan_name else 'vip_yearly'
4050:                 
4051:                 tier = plan_type.split('_')[0] if plan_type else 'pro'
4052:                 
4053:                 # Get the Flutterwave subscription ID from the response
4054:                 # This comes from the payment_plan subscription
4055:                 flw_subscription_id = data['data'].get('subscription_id') or data['data'].get('payment_plan_id')
4056:                 
4057:                 # If we don't have a subscription_id, we need to fetch it
4058:                 if not flw_subscription_id:
4059:                     # Try to get subscription from the transaction
4060:                     transaction_data = data['data']
4061:                     if transaction_data.get('payment_plan'):
4062:                         # The subscription might be in the payment_plan object
4063:                         flw_subscription_id = transaction_data.get('payment_plan', {}).get('id')
4064:                 
4065:                 # Calculate expiry based on plan type
4066:                 # Flutterwave handles the recurring billing, but we track it in our DB too
4067:                 if '_yearly' in plan_type:
4068:                     expiry = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=365)
4069:                 else:
4070:                     expiry = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=30)
4071:                 
4072:                 conn = get_db()
4073:                 try:
4074:                     cursor = conn.cursor()
4075:                     cursor.execute("""
4076:                         UPDATE users 
4077:                         SET subscription_tier = %s,
4078:                             subscription_status = 'active',
4079:                             subscription_expiry = %s,
4080:                             flw_subscription_id = %s
4081:                         WHERE id = %s
4082:                     """, (tier, expiry, flw_subscription_id, user_id))
4083:                     conn.commit()
4084:                     cursor.close()
4085:                     print(f"✅ User {user_id} upgraded to {tier} (expires {expiry}, FLW ID: {flw_subscription_id})")
4086:                 finally:
4087:                     put_db(conn)
4088:                 
4089:                 flash("✅ Payment successful! Your subscription is now active.", "success")
4090:                 return redirect(url_for("home"))
4091:             else:
4092:                 flash("Payment failed. Please try again.", "error")
4093:                 return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4094:         else:
4095:             flash("Error verifying payment. Please contact support.", "error")
4096:             return redirect(url_for("pricing"))
4097:             
4098:     except Exception as e:
4099:         print(f"❌ Callback error: {e}")
4100:         import traceback
4101:         traceback.print_exc()
4102:         flash("Error verifying payment. Please contact support.", "error")
4103:         return redirect(url_for("pricing"))

4119: @app.route("/webhook/flutterwave", methods=["POST"])
4120: @csrf.exempt
4121: @limiter.exempt
4122: def flutterwave_webhook():
4123:     """Handle Flutterwave webhook for subscription events."""
4124:     try:
4125:         data = request.json
4126:         if not data:
4127:             print("❌ No JSON data received")
4128:             return "No data", 400
4129:         
4130:         print(f"📨 Webhook received at {datetime.now(timezone.utc)}")
4131:         print(f"📨 Event: {data.get('event', 'unknown')}")
4132:         print(f"📨 Full data: {data}")
4133:         
4134:         signature = request.headers.get('verif-hash')
4135: 
4136:         # --- CRITICAL: Enable Signature Verification ---
4137:         if not verify_flutterwave_webhook(data, signature):
4138:             print("❌ Webhook signature verification failed.")
4139:             return "Invalid Signature", 401
4140:         # -------------------------------------------------
4141: 
4142:         if signature:
4143:             print(f"📨 Signature: {signature[:20]}...")
4144:         
4145:         try:
4146:             event = data.get('event')
4147:             
4148:             if event == 'charge.completed':
4149:                 print("✅ Payment completed webhook received")
4150:                 
4151:                 webhook_data = data.get('data', {})
4152: 
4153:                 # --- Reject test/mock transactions when not running in test mode ---
4154:                 if webhook_data.get('test_mode', False) and not is_test_mode():
4155:                     print("⚠️ Ignoring test-mode webhook transaction in production")
4156:                     return "OK", 200
4157:                 # -------------------------------------------------------------------
4158:                 
4159:                 user_id = None
4160:                 plan_type = None
4161:                 meta = webhook_data.get('meta', {})
4162:                 if meta:
4163:                     user_id = meta.get('user_id')
4164:                     plan_type = meta.get('plan_type', 'pro_monthly')
4165:                 
4166:                 if not user_id:
4167:                     customer = webhook_data.get('customer', {})
4168:                     email = customer.get('email')
4169:                     if email:
4170:                         print(f"📨 Looking up user by email: {email}")
4171:                         user = get_user_by_email(email)
4172:                         if user:
4173:                             user_id = user[0]
4174:                 
4175:                 if user_id:
4176:                     tier = plan_type.split('_')[0] if plan_type else 'pro'
4177:                     
4178:                     # Calculate expiry
4179:                     if '_yearly' in plan_type:
4180:                         expiry = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=365)
4181:                     else:
4182:                         expiry = datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=30)
4183:                     
4184:                     # Get subscription ID from webhook
4185:                     flw_subscription_id = webhook_data.get('subscription_id') or webhook_data.get('payment_plan_id')
4186:                     
4187:                     conn = get_db()
4188:                     try:
4189:                         cursor = conn.cursor()
4190:                         cursor.execute("""
4191:                             UPDATE users 
4192:                             SET subscription_tier = %s,
4193:                                 subscription_status = 'active',
4194:                                 subscription_expiry = %s,
4195:                                 flw_subscription_id = %s
4196:                             WHERE id = %s
4197:                         """, (tier, expiry, flw_subscription_id, user_id))
4198:                         conn.commit()
4199:                         cursor.close()
4200:                         print(f"✅ User {user_id} upgraded to {tier} via webhook (expires {expiry})")
4201:                     except Exception as db_error:
4202:                         print(f"❌ Database error: {db_error}")
4203:                     finally:
4204:                         put_db(conn)
4205:                 else:
4206:                     print(f"⚠️ Could not find user for webhook: {data}")
4207:             
4208:             elif event == 'subscription.cancelled':
4209:                 print("❌ Subscription cancelled webhook received")
4210:                 webhook_data = data.get('data', {})
4211:                 
4212:                 # Find user by subscription ID
4213:                 subscription_id = webhook_data.get('id')
4214:                 if subscription_id:
4215:                     conn = get_db()
4216:                     try:
4217:                         cursor = conn.cursor()
4218:                         cursor.execute("""
4219:                             UPDATE users 
4220:                             SET subscription_status = 'cancelled'
4221:                             WHERE flw_subscription_id = %s
4222:                         """, (subscription_id,))
4223:                         conn.commit()
4224:                         print(f"✅ User with FLW subscription {subscription_id} marked as cancelled")
4225:                     except Exception as db_error:
4226:                         print(f"❌ Database error: {db_error}")
4227:                     finally:
4228:                         put_db(conn)
4229:             
4230:             elif event == 'subscription.expired':
4231:                 print("⏰ Subscription expired webhook received")
4232:                 webhook_data = data.get('data', {})
4233:                 
4234:                 # Find user by subscription ID and downgrade
4235:                 subscription_id = webhook_data.get('id')
4236:                 if subscription_id:
4237:                     conn = get_db()
4238:                     try:
4239:                         cursor = conn.cursor()
4240:                         cursor.execute("""
4241:                             SELECT id FROM users WHERE flw_subscription_id = %s
4242:                         """, (subscription_id,))
4243:                         user_result = cursor.fetchone()
4244:                         
4245:                         if user_result:
4246:                             user_id = user_result[0]
4247:                             # Trim documents to free limit
4248:                             trim_documents_to_free_limit(user_id)
4249:                             cursor.execute("""
4250:                                 UPDATE users 
4251:                                 SET subscription_tier = 'free',
4252:                                     subscription_status = 'expired',
4253:                                     subscription_expiry = NULL,
4254:                                     flw_subscription_id = NULL
4255:                                 WHERE id = %s
4256:                             """, (user_id,))
4257:                             conn.commit()
4258:                             print(f"✅ User {user_id} downgraded to Free via webhook")
4259:                     except Exception as db_error:
4260:                         print(f"❌ Database error: {db_error}")
4261:                     finally:
4262:                         put_db(conn)
4263:             
4264:             else:
4265:                 print(f"ℹ️ Unhandled webhook event: {event}")
4266:                 
4267:         except Exception as process_error:
4268:             print(f"❌ Error processing webhook: {process_error}")
4269:             import traceback
4270:             traceback.print_exc()
4271:         
4272:         return "OK", 200
4273:         
4274:     except Exception as e:
4275:         print(f"❌ Webhook error: {e}")
4276:         import traceback
4277:         traceback.print_exc()
4278:         return "OK", 200

4280: @app.route("/cron/reminders")
4281: @limiter.exempt  # Cron jobs should NEVER be rate limited
4282: def run_reminders():
4283:     """Endpoint triggered by cron-job.org to send daily reminders."""
4284:     provided_token = request.args.get("token") or request.headers.get("X-Trigger-Token")
4285:     
4286:     if provided_token != TRIGGER_SECRET:
4287:         abort(401, "Unauthorized: Invalid token")
4288:     
4289:     try:
4290:         import reminders
4291:         reminders.check_and_send_reminders()
4292:         return "✅ Reminders sent successfully.", 200
4293:     except Exception as e:
4294:         return f"❌ Reminders failed: {str(e)}", 500

4300: @app.route("/newsletter/subscribe", methods=["POST"])
4301: @limiter.limit("5 per hour", error_message="Too many subscription attempts. Please wait an hour.")
4302: def subscribe_newsletter():
4303:     """Subscribe to newsletter."""
4304:     email = request.form.get("email", "").strip().lower()
4305:     
4306:     if not email:
4307:         flash("Please enter your email address.", "error")
4308:         return redirect(url_for("home"))
4309:     
4310:     conn = get_db()
4311:     try:
4312:         cursor = conn.cursor()
4313:         cursor.execute(
4314:             "INSERT INTO newsletter_subscribers (email, subscribed_at) VALUES (%s, %s) ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING",
4315:             (email, datetime.now(timezone.utc))
4316:         )
4317:         conn.commit()
4318:         cursor.close()
4319:     finally:
4320:         put_db(conn)
4321:     
4322:     flash("✅ Thanks for subscribing! You'll hear from us soon.", "success")
4323:     return redirect(url_for("home"))

4326: @app.route("/admin/newsletter")
4327: def newsletter_admin():
4328:     """Admin page to view newsletter subscribers."""
4329:     auth = require_admin()
4330:     if auth:
4331:         return auth
4332:     
4333:     conn = get_db()
4334:     try:
4335:         cursor = conn.cursor()
4336:         cursor.execute("SELECT email, subscribed_at FROM newsletter_subscribers ORDER BY subscribed_at DESC")
4337:         subscribers = cursor.fetchall()
4338:         cursor.close()
4339:     finally:
4340:         put_db(conn)
4341:     
4342:     return render_template("admin/newsletter.html", subscribers=subscribers)

4351: def _base_url():
4352:     """Return the canonical base URL (with scheme)."""
4353:     base = os.environ.get("APP_URL", "tracker.fritt.org")
4354:     if not base.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
4355:         base = f"https://{base}"
4356:     return base.rstrip("/")

4426: @app.route("/sitemap.xml")
4427: @limiter.exempt
4428: def sitemap():
4429:     """Generate sitemap.xml for search engines."""
4430:     from flask import Response
4431: 
4432:     base = _base_url()
4433:     today = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
4434: 
4435:     static_pages = [
4436:         ("/", "1.0", "weekly"),
4437:         ("/pricing", "0.9", "weekly"),
4438:         ("/business", "0.8", "monthly"),
4439:         ("/resources", "0.9", "weekly"),
4440:         ("/use-cases", "0.8", "weekly"),
4441:         ("/compare/spreadsheets-vs-fritt-tracker", "0.8", "monthly"),
4442:         ("/contact", "0.5", "monthly"),
4443:         ("/feedback", "0.4", "monthly"),
4444:         ("/terms", "0.2", "yearly"),
4445:         ("/privacy", "0.2", "yearly"),
4446:     ]
4447: 
4448:     xml = ['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>']
4449:     xml.append('<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">')
4450: 
4451:     for path, priority, freq in static_pages:
4452:         xml.append(
4453:             f"  <url>\n"
4454:             f"    <loc>{base}{path}</loc>\n"
4455:             f"    <lastmod>{today}</lastmod>\n"
4456:             f"    <changefreq>{freq}</changefreq>\n"
4457:             f"    <priority>{priority}</priority>\n"
4458:             f"  </url>"
4459:         )
4460: 
4461:     for a in RESOURCE_ARTICLES:
4462:         xml.append(
4463:             f"  <url>\n"
4464:             f"    <loc>{base}/resources/{a['slug']}</loc>\n"
4465:             f"    <lastmod>{today}</lastmod>\n"
4466:             f"    <changefreq>monthly</changefreq>\n"
4467:             f"    <priority>0.7</priority>\n"
4468:             f"  </url>"
4469:         )
4470: 
4471:     for u in USE_CASES:
4472:         xml.append(
4473:             f"  <url>\n"
4474:             f"    <loc>{base}/use-cases/{u['slug']}</loc>\n"
4475:             f"    <lastmod>{today}</lastmod>\n"
4476:             f"    <changefreq>monthly</changefreq>\n"
4477:             f"    <priority>0.7</priority>\n"
4478:             f"  </url>"
4479:         )
4480: 
4481:     xml.append("</urlset>")
4482:     return Response("\n".join(xml), mimetype="application/xml")
